verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents replaying archived events into a new destination or backfilling history to a newly added tool. Warehouse Sync only ingests data from a customer's own warehouse into mParticle, which is an adjacent ingestion feature rather than event replay or backfill. The 'Feeds' and 'Forward data to downstream services' items are bare titles with no replay content.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can replay archived events into a new destination or backfill history when a tool is added or a pipeline breaks
